title: BRAT Research Platform
summary: A conversational role-play and coaching platform that lets parents rehearse difficult conversations with a simulated child, built for a UT Austin parenting research study.
overview: BRAT (Boundaries, Resilience and Affection Training) is a conversational role-play and coaching platform where parents practice difficult conversations with a simulated child before trying them at home. It operationalizes PMTO (Parent Management Training, Oregon), an evidence-based parent-training model, into LLM-driven role-play with technique-level feedback. BRAT is a production research platform for a UT Austin parenting study, developed with collaborators across partner universities.
myRole: As product lead and AI engineer, I translated research requirements into the platform's design and implementation. I built the conversational system, the safety and moderation layer, and the researcher-facing tooling, and integrated the study-operations workflows that move participants from screening through practice and review.

sections.title: Platform & Conversational System
content: Built the role-play and coaching platform on Next.js, React, and Node, deployed on Azure App Service with Azure Blob Storage and a PostgreSQL data layer.
Implemented PMTO-informed conversational fidelity metrics across dialogue turns, giving researchers a structured way to assess session quality.
Contributed safety guardrails, input and output moderation rules, and session-review workflows for participant-facing interactions.

sections.title: Study Operations & Researcher Tooling
content: Integrated Qualtrics-based screening, consent, and onboarding into the platform, standardizing participant handoff.
Built a researcher dashboard for session retrieval, transcript review, and participant progress monitoring.
Built a quantitative data pipeline enabling clinician and researcher review of multilingual interaction data.

outcomes: Deployed a production research platform supporting a UT Austin parenting study.
Implemented PMTO-informed fidelity metrics that let researchers assess session quality at the level of technique.
Standardized participant screening, consent, and onboarding through integrated Qualtrics workflows.
Built researcher tooling for transcript review and progress monitoring across multilingual sessions.
